chipsetCatalog.scope: Documented eligibility, per-chip catalogs, paths, runtime packaging and negative guards

qualityObservations: Runtime regression success means the engines loaded and met the listed checks, not that every translation was accurate. Qwen3-0.6B returned mixed-language text (请缓慢 speak.) for Please speak slowly.; it remains experimental. SenseVoice single-utterance regression had word error rate 0.047619 on the synthetic English fixture; the paced sustained test is a different segmentation path.

fixture.description: Repeated 10.52-second synthetic English meeting announcement; no real microphone recording is exported.

validationHistory: Initial microphone UI test failed the screen-off audio update assertion; it did not record enough screen-state detail to determine the cause. The test instrumentation was extended to record screen-off/background samples and all audio updates. The repeat passed on the same production APK with 240 screen-off samples and 2919 screen-off audio updates; no production code was changed for this repeat.
limitations: One physical phone; this is not physical validation of other chipsets or Android versions.
Thirty-minute test feeds a repeated 10.52-second English fixture through the real VAD/ASR/translation pipeline at normal pace every 15 seconds; it does not prove translation quality on other speech.
Battery/temperature measurements describe the entire unplugged phone under this workload, not isolated app power consumption.
The foreground microphone service test is shorter than the inference soak; no 30-minute MediaProjection capture or all-day/OEM background survival claim.
Output-token exhaustion protection cannot detect semantic omissions in otherwise normally terminated model output.
AGP 8.10.1 lint emits Kotlin 2.4 metadata diagnostics; Java compilation and lint tasks complete, with existing lint warnings retained.
